xmldoc.short_description: Convert surface data to patch data.

param_input_item.param_description: the surface coordinates. X and Y may be vectors or matrices; Z is a matrix with at least two rows and two columns.
the color data; defaults to Z when omitted.
a surface object whose data is converted.

param_output_item.param_description: a structure with the fields 'faces', 'vertices' and 'facevertexcdata', suitable for patch.
the faces, vertices and face/vertex color data returned separately.

description.p: surf2patch converts the geometry of a surface into the faces and vertices of a patch. The grid of a (m)-by-(n) surface becomes (m-1)*(n-1) quadrilateral faces (or twice as many triangular faces with the 'triangles' option).
Called with a single output, the result is a structure that can be passed directly to patch; with several outputs the faces, vertices and color data are returned separately.
